name: jm-tools
description: Working tools: continuation handoffs for a fresh session, adversarial try-to-break checks, before/after visual evidence for UI changes, static hosting, feedback logging, and Codex session export.

interface.shortDescription: Handoffs, adversarial checks, visual evidence, hosting, feedback, session export
interface.longDescription: handoff writes a continuation packet so work can resume in a fresh session. try-to-break tries to break a change on purpose and reports what fails, with evidence. visual-evidence takes matching before/after screenshots of UI changes. host-static hosts a built static folder at an unlisted URL. feedback records the user's feedback in FEEDBACK.md. codex-session-export finds and exports the Codex sessions behind a project.
defaultPrompt: Write a handoff so I can continue in a fresh session.
